character: vain mink, sleek glossy dark-brown fur, in a rich sheepskin coat embroidered with red, blue and yellow patterns and a tall black fur papakha, smug, always in motion
props: picket fence across a snowy yard, two pickets set wide apart, fence intact all clip; smoking grill with shashlik beyond; metal skewers; torn strips of embroidered sheepskin; five scruffy half-rats at the pickets close to the lens — scrawny father, fat mother, three kids, patchy dull fur
motion_rule: mink crosses to a new spot every window and never speaks from one place, her own action is only striding, spinning and leaping; shot size changes every window; the rats grab, haul and tear at her coat every window, large and close to the lens
environment: snowy backyard, bright sunny midday, hard shadows

audio.delivery: smug female voice, native Russian stress, calm
audio.pronunciation: stress: shi-KAR-ny, no-SHU, se-BYA, GLAV-no-ye in three clear syllables, sa-SYE-di, za-VEE-do-va-li — never ZA-vi-do-va-li
audio.pacing: brisk lively pacing, no drawling, lines fit the windows
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: snow crunch, teeth clacking, tearing cloth, squeaks

timeline.a: mink bursts from a snowbank in a blast of snow, coat flaring | all five rats snap their heads round and pour off the grill at her
mink flings the coat open, dark fur blazing at the lens | a kid already swinging on the hem is torn off and tumbles into the snow
mink strides on along the fence, heels ploughing snow | two rats clamped to the hem in their teeth are dragged behind her, digging in their heels
mink spins hard, coat flying out in a full circle | both rats are flung off in a wide arc and crash into the snowbank
mink strides through, shaking snow off in a fan | father vaults the grill, thrusts both paws over the pickets and rips the skewers out of her paw
mink glides along the pickets right to left | mother locks her teeth on the papakha and hauls, all four kids pile onto the coat tail, the whole family skidding through the snow behind her
mink leaps a snowbank, coat and fur fanning mid-air | the papakha rips loose in mother's teeth, kids hanging off the tail are dragged through the air with her
mother's snarling muzzle fills the lens, bared teeth, skewer gripped in her fist, shreds of papakha fur in her mouth | mink shrinks back clutching the coat
all five rats launch off the pickets in one heap and bury the mink, the coat vanishing under bodies
the heap thrashes, torn strips of embroidered sheepskin and papakha fluff spraying into the lens
mink's paw shoots out of the heap gripping one strip, mother yanks it back, the strip snaps between them
mink tears free bare-furred, shreds trailing, scrabbling backwards through the snow to the fence, two kids still riding her tail
mink squeezes between the two wide pickets, whining, ribs scraping, boards bowing apart, kids shaken off
mink drops onto her own side, back to the fence, panting | beyond it the five rats fight over the shreds, mother pulling a strip over her head

must_appear: fence intact every frame; her bare fur close and glinting at 0.3-1.55; rats hauling at the coat in every speech window; skewers taken at 3.3; the whole family dragged behind her at 4.05; mother's bared teeth filling the lens at 6.55; the coat torn to shreds 7.05-8.55; mink squeezing between the pickets at 9.05
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, subtitles, captions, watermark, static camera, locked-off shots, same shot size twice, only her head moving, speaking from one spot, a window where the rats do nothing, the fence breaking, blood, wounds, extra limbs, character changing mid-shot, English speech, Latin letters, any word after 6.55
